Here’s an enhanced README.md formatted in Markdown for your GitHub project. Just copy-paste this into your repo at the root alongside your existing files:


---

# 🦊 Ethereum Wallet Viewer — Safe App

A TypeScript-powered Safe App for viewing Ethereum Safe (multisig) details: owners, threshold, balances, ENS resolution, QR code support—and featuring a callback flow after setup.

**🔗 Live:** [https://funds123.github.io/ethereum_wallet_view_safe_app](https://funds123.github.io/ethereum_wallet_view_safe_app)

---

## 🚀 Features

- ✅ Display Safe owners and threshold
- ✅ Show token balances (ETH, USDC, DAI, WBTC, USDT)
- ✅ ENS address resolution for human-readable addresses
- ✅ QR code scanner for loading wallet addresses
- ✅ Safe App SDK compatibility for full Safe context
- ✅ Callback redirect support after Safe setup completion
- ✅ Deployable via GitHub Pages or similar static hosting
- ✅ Compatible across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon, zkSync, Gnosis, etc.

---

## 🛠️ Setup & Development

```bash
git clone https://github.com/funds123/ethereum_wallet_view_safe_app.git
cd ethereum_wallet_view_safe_app
npm install
npm run dev

The app uses Vite, React, and TypeScript for fast development cycles.


---

🧪 Building for Production

npm run build
npm run preview

The compiled output lands in dist/.


---

📡 Callback Flow After Safe Setup

Upon a successful Safe setup transaction, redirect users to the callback page with the transaction hash:

window.location.href = `https://funds123.github.io/ethereum_wallet_view_safe_app/callback?txHash=${tx.hash}`;

📍 The callback page displays confirmation and can optionally trigger backend logic (via webhook).


---

📦 Deploying to GitHub Pages

1. Update vite.config.ts to include:

export default defineConfig({
  base: '/ethereum_wallet_view_safe_app/',
});


2. Add .github/workflows/deploy.yml:

name: Deploy Safe App

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with: { node-version: 18 }
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./dist


3. Commit and push:

git add .
git commit -m "Deploy Safe App to GitHub Pages"
git push



Your app will be live at:
https://funds123.github.io/ethereum_wallet_view_safe_app


---

📚 Safe App SDK Example

import SafeAppsSDK from '@safe-global/safe-apps-sdk';

const sdk = new SafeAppsSDK();

async function init() {
  const safeInfo = await sdk.safe.getInfo();
  console.log('Connected Safe:', safeInfo);
}
init();


---

├── callback.html
